java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region

net.tessel.fx.components.Expander
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class Expander extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
A header that shows or hides a content area, with an animated chevron. 
Expander details = new Expander("Details", content, true);
